The 2020 Formula 1 drivers' championship was won by Lewis Hamilton. He finished on 347 points with 11 wins, ahead of Valtteri Bottas (223 points) and Max Verstappen (214 points). Mercedes also took the constructors' title that year.

ANSWER: Lewis Hamilton
